title: 1988 SAIC anti-gravity study for Edwards Air Force Base

tellings.quote: 1988, the corporation SAIC was tasked with studying electric propulsion and anti-gravity for Edwards Air Force Base.

plain: In 1988 a corporation known as SAIC was hired to study electric propulsion and anti-gravity, meaning ways to fly by cancelling or pushing against gravity, for Edwards Air Force Base, a US Air Force base in California. Michels tells this himself in his documentary on the inventor Townsend Brown, naming James Woodward and Ferris Williams in connection with the study. He raises it to show that the military was still quietly looking into anti-gravity decades after Brown's work.
